_comment: wiki ingest must mint <!--obs:XXXXXX--> markers on every observation it writes, same invariant as cmdWrite/cmdPatch. Exercises three ingest write sites: new entity body, new event body, and patch add_facts onto an existing page.

facts.body: Newly born entity carries an obs id marker on its fact
Newly born event carries an obs id marker on its fact

add_facts.body: Patched fact must also carry an obs id marker
